definitions: The part of an economy that is neither taxed nor monitored by any form of government.
Economic activities that are not regulated or protected by the state, often characterized by small-scale, self-employment, and lack of formal contracts.
examples: Many people in developing countries rely on the informal sector for their livelihoods.
The informal sector often provides goods and services at lower prices.
Policies are being developed to integrate the informal sector into the formal economy.
